_comment: Eligibility window per league. max_days_out doubles as the commenceTimeTo bound on the odds fetch (one knob fixes volatility + volume). requires = data-readiness gate (lock only when the signal is present). edge_scale_per_day: effective_threshold = base * (1 + edge_scale_per_day * days_to_game), so far-out locks must clear a higher bar. Starting values per architecture proposal; §11.3 monthly job replaces these with measurement.
